params.name: api_key
params.description: Your unique API key for the Avatars API.

params.name: name
params.description: Full name or initials to use for the avatar.

params.name: size
params.description: Size of the avatar in pixels (square). Defaults to 128.

params.name: color
params.description: Text color as a hex code (without

params.name: background_color
params.description: Background color as a hex code (without

params.name: font_size
params.description: Font size as a fraction of the avatar size (0.1 to 0.9).

params.name: char_count
params.description: Number of characters to use from the name. Defaults to 2.

items.docs: Generate a customizable avatar image using a person's name or initials with configurable colors, fonts, and sizes.
